intro.zh: 从找不同、街机到像素冒险，看看这些各具风格的游戏。
intro.en: From spot-the-difference puzzles to arcade action and pixel adventures, find a game to explore.

zh.title: 网页游戏：街机、解谜与冒险｜Freemy
zh.description: 浏览真实作品预览，发现找不同、街机、像素冒险和太空探索游戏，并前往创作者原站。

en.title: Browser Games: Arcade, Puzzles & Adventures | Freemy
en.description: Preview browser games ranging from spot-the-difference puzzles and arcade action to pixel and space adventures.

intro.zh: 从流体、光学到引力沙盒，这些互动实验邀请你观察变化。
intro.en: Explore changing systems through interactive experiments with fluids, optics, gravity and more.

zh.title: 互动实验：流体、光学与引力｜Freemy
zh.description: 预览液压、摆动、光学和轨道等互动实验，观察模型如何变化，再前往作品原站探索。

en.title: Interactive Experiments: Fluids, Optics & Gravity | Freemy
en.description: Preview interactive experiments with hydraulics, pendulums, optics and orbits, then explore the original works.

intro.zh: 从折纸到发动机，在可探索的模型和步骤中认识新事物。
intro.en: Explore ideas step by step, from folding paper to examining engines and satellite orbits.

zh.title: 互动教程与模型：从折纸到发动机｜Freemy
zh.description: 探索折纸步骤、发动机模型、卫星轨道和更多互动学习作品，先看预览再访问创作者原站。

en.title: Interactive Learning: Models, Science & Making | Freemy
en.description: Discover interactive learning works about paper folding, engines, satellite orbits and other ideas worth exploring.

intro.zh: 声音、文字、画面与图案，在这里交汇成可探索的创意作品。
intro.en: Explore creative works where sound, typography, images and patterns meet.

zh.title: 互动艺术与声音：音乐、绘画和视觉实验｜Freemy
zh.description: 发现网页乐器、声音可视化、绘图机与水彩风景等创意作品，查看预览并访问原站。

en.title: Interactive Art & Sound: Music and Visual Experiments | Freemy
en.description: Discover browser instruments, sound visualizations, drawing machines and other creative works.

intro.zh: 用颜色、图形和字体创作，试试从配色到对称绘画的轻量工具。
intro.en: Make something with color, shapes and type using small creative tools.

zh.title: 创意小应用：配色、绘画与字体设计｜Freemy
zh.description: 预览配色、对称绘画、模块字体与三维瓶型设计工具，找到下一次创作的灵感。

en.title: Creative Mini Apps: Color, Drawing & Type | Freemy
en.description: Explore small tools for color palettes, symmetrical drawing, modular type and 3D bottle design.

intro.zh: 走进画廊、庭园、虚构星球和三维场景，换个视角探索。
intro.en: Step into galleries, gardens, fictional planets and other spaces to explore from a new perspective.

zh.title: 三维空间与虚拟世界：画廊、庭园和星球｜Freemy
zh.description: 浏览三维画廊、庭园、海上风场与虚构星球的真实预览，进入创作者的空间作品。

en.title: 3D Spaces & Virtual Worlds: Galleries, Gardens & Planets | Freemy
en.description: Preview 3D galleries, gardens, offshore wind farms and fictional planets before visiting the original works.
